login.lead: See your own moderation record in {server}: your warnings, warning-ladder level, any active ban or mute, your cases and your appeals.
login.withAccount: Log in with a Mewvo account
login.note: Mewvo asks Discord only who you are (the identify permission): no email, no servers, nothing else. You only ever see your own record. The login lasts one hour.
login.signup: No Mewvo account yet? [Create one]({href}) to log in with a username and password.

record.title: My record
record.lead: Your moderation record in {server}, logged in as **{username}**. Only you can see this.
record.warningsNote: Counted warnings at your level. Warnings do not expire.
record.noAppeals: You have not filed any appeals.
record.appealHintInvite: Appeal from the appeal panel in Discord: [join the support server]({invite}) and press **Appeal** with the case code. Nothing can be appealed from this page.
record.appealHint: Appeal from the appeal panel in Discord with the case code. Nothing can be appealed from this page.
